labelChirho: to rise, come up (of the sun)
descriptionChirho: Of the sun or daylight rising, coming up, or dawning in its literal astronomical sense, including intransitive and participial forms describing the sun's natural motion.

labelChirho: to cause to rise, make the sun shine
descriptionChirho: Causative use: God causes the sun to rise upon people, with the subject as the agent who makes light appear (Matt 5:45).

labelChirho: to dawn (figurative, of light upon people)
descriptionChirho: Metaphorical use of light dawning upon those in spiritual darkness, referencing messianic prophecy fulfillment (Matt 4:16 citing Isa 9:2).

labelChirho: to spring up, arise (of a person or tribe)
descriptionChirho: Of a person or descendant arising or springing forth from a tribe or lineage, used of Christ's descent from Judah (Heb 7:14).
